title: What’s in a Query: Polarity-Aware Distribution-Based Fair Ranking

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring disparities between cumulative attention and relevance distributions across male and female groups in ranking systems (using synthetic hiring, rateMDs, and Xing datasets) via divergence metrics (L1, L2 variance, W1) while accounting for query polarity.

Measuring differences in cumulative attention and relevance allocation across Wikipedia articles associated with different geographic locations (Europe/North America, No continent, Others) in the FairTREC 2021 dataset using distribution-aware divergence metrics.
